scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
issuing_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
target_group: Meritorious students from low-income families in regular graduate, postgraduate or professional degree courses

eligibility_rules.description: Above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream of the Class XII board examination
eligibility_rules.note: Onboarding does not collect this yet; ask only if the user has it

eligibility_rules.description: Gross parental or family income from all sources up to Rs 4,50,000 per year
Pursuing a regular degree course, not correspondence, distance or diploma
Course at an institution recognised by AICTE or the relevant regulatory body, with a valid AISHE code
Not availing any other scholarship scheme, including state schemes and fee waiver or reimbursement
Renewal: at least 50% marks in the annual examination and 75% attendance

benefits.component: Technical courses such as B.Tech and B.Engg
benefits.amount_per_year: Rs 12,000 in years 1-3; Rs 20,000 in year 4 (graduation level only)

slot_note: Only about 82,000 fresh scholarships a year, allocated by state board and stream. Meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award (paras 2 and 3).
required_documents: Caste certificate if claiming reservation (verified through DigiLocker, para 6(i))
Academic qualification proof (verified through DigiLocker, para 6(i))
Bank account in the student's name (para 8)
application_steps: Register on NSP (scholarships.gov.in) and apply online only (paras 4(ix), 6(i))
The institution verifies first, then the state nodal agency (para 6(v))
Check the selection list on NSP (para 6(iv))
Renewals must be filed by the cut-off date on NSP (para 6(vii))
payment: DBT to the student's bank account; can be tracked on PFMS (para 8)
deadline_note: NSP publishes the timelines (para 6(ii)). The guideline gives no fixed date.
source_document: PM-USP CSSS guidelines, applicable from 2022-23 onwards (uploaded Guidelines_DOHE_CSSS.pdf)
